claim: Cycling Through the Trees (Fietsen door de Bomen) in Pijnven/Bosland is only 12 km by bike from Lommel center, with suggested routes starting at Parking de Soeverein (node 224, 38.7 km loop) or Parking House of Nature (50.7 km loop).
quote: From the center of Lommel it is only 12 km by bike to the iconic bike bridge... Full route (50.7 km): Begins at Parking House of Nature (between nodes 224-230); Shorter alternative (38.7 km): Starts at Parking Soeverein (node 224)

claim: The double circular bridge in Pijnven rises gradually to 10 m so cyclists ride 700 m through the treetops at node 272, address Kiefhoekstraat 16, Hechtel-Eksel, with free parking; the installation opened June 2019 and travel is one-directional.
quote: Via a double circular bicycle bridge, you gradually rise to a height of 10 meters, where you cycle among the treetops, and the 700-meter route takes you through a wonderful world of green... Opened June 2019... Free parking available at the site

claim: The official Visit Limburg Cycling Through the Trees route is 38 km on flat terrain, starting at junction 272 in Hechtel-Eksel, passing the German military cemetery in Lommel, with downloadable GPX and PDF map.
quote: Route Length: 38 km; Difficulty: Flat terrain; Starting Point: Junction 272 in Hechtel-Eksel... Passes the German military cemetery in Lommel

claim: Cycling Through Water (Fietsen door het Water) is at node 91 in Bokrijk (Pad z/n, 3600 Genk), a 200+ m path through a pond with water at eye level, accessible to walkers/joggers with two car parks at Bokrijklaan 1.
quote: Cycling through Water in Bokrijk is a unique cycling experience in which you cycle more than 200 meters through a pond... node 91 of the cycle node network in Bokrijk... Enter Bokrijklaan 1, 3600 Genk as the GPS address

claim: A Lommel-to-Bokrijk cycling route covers 43.66 km, putting the Cycling Through Water installation well outside a 30 km radius from Cuchara (driving distance is similar at 44.4 km).
quote: A cycling route from Lommel to Bokrijk is 43.66 km... For reference, the driving distance between Bokrijk and Lommel is 44.4 km

claim: Cycling Through the Heathland is in Maasmechelen between nodes 550-551 in Hoge Kempen National Park, a 4 km route with a ~300 m wooden bridge over 700 ha of Mechelse Heide; no parking at the bridge itself — visitors park at Terhills, De Lieteberg, Station As, Kattevennen or Pietersheim gateways.
quote: Location/Town: Maasmechelen, within Hoge Kempen National Park... Route Length: 4 kilometers; Starting Node Points: Cycle nodes 550-551... No parking available at the trailhead itself. Visitors must park at designated gateway entrances: Terhills Maasmechelen...

claim: Limburg's fietsroutenetwerk covers 1,800+ km of signposted cycling routes connected by numbered knooppunten on blue eye-level signs; the node system was invented in Belgian Limburg by mine engineer Hugo Bollen after the 1980s coal-mine closures.
quote: The cycling route network of Fietsparadijs Limburg consists of more than 1,800 km of cycling routes, connected via knooppunten... When coal mines in Belgian Limburg closed in the 1980s, mine engineer Hugo Bollen proposed a project to create a cycling and walking route network

claim: A 16.5 km child-friendly Sahara loop runs from Parking Soeverein (Speelpleinstraat 77, Lommel) via nodes 224-230-231-232-260-224, paved with only 15 m elevation, visiting the House of Nature sculpture, Bocholt-Herentals canal, pedestrian bridge, Blauwe Kei and the Sahara dunes/blue lake.
quote: Route Length: 16.5 km... cycling nodes 224–230–231–232–260–224... Parking de Soeverein is available at Speelpleinstraat 77, 3920 Lommel... House of Nature sculpture (7.5m high, 50m wide)... easy difficulty level with only 15m elevation gain

claim: Nationaal Park Bosland offers the Mountainbikenetwerk Noord-Limburg with 270 km of signposted MTB trails across Lommel, Peer, Pelt, Hechtel-Eksel, Bocholt and Hamont-Achel, plus five combinable MTB loops in Lommel (Kattenbos, Sahara, Heuvelse Heide).
quote: Mountainbikenetwerk Noord-Limburg - A comprehensive network spanning 270 kilometers through the Sahara and Pijnven areas, connecting Lommel, Peer, Pelt, Hechtel-Eksel, Bocholt, and Hamont-Achel... MTB routes in Lommel - Five loops, some combinable

claim: BoslandBike 2026 (Sunday 26 April) is a gravel/MTB festival starting at Forestique (Witherendreef 1, 3900 Pelt), with 100 km gravel and MTB courses (€39.50) and 10/25/50 km family routes (€5); registration opened 1 November 2025.
quote: BoslandBike occurs on Sunday, April 26, 2026, in and around National Park Bosland. The event starts and finishes at Forestique (Witherendreef 1, 3900 Pelt)... Gravel 100km (€39.50)... Family Routes (€5.00) - Distances: 10km, 25km, or 50km

claim: Recommended Hechtel-Eksel rides include the Cycling Through the Trees - Butterfly Valley Lommel Loop (16.2 km, easy, starts at Natuurreservaat Veewei) and the 18.1 km De Boom In by Will Beckers loop from Eksel through Bosland.
quote: Cycling through the Trees – Butterfly Valley Lommel Loop - Distance: 16.2 km; Duration: 57 minutes; Difficulty: Easy; Starting Point: Natuurreservaat Veewei... De Boom In by Will Beckers – Cycling through the Trees Loop - Distance: 18.1 km

claim: Visit Limburg cancelled the planned fifth 'Fietsen onder de Grond' (Cycling Underground) installation in Riemst in September 2025 due to insufficient local support; the four realised experiences are Water (Bokrijk), Trees (Bosland), Heathland and Mine Terrils (both Hoge Kempen).
quote: Visit Limburg decided to stop the 'Cycling Underground' project in the Mergelland because, although the second permit application was positively assessed, there was insufficient local support... the other 4 cycling experiences that were successfully realized include 'Cycling through Water' in Bokrijk, 'Cycling through the Trees' in National Park Bosland, 'Cycling through the Heathland,' and 'Cycling among the Mine Terrils'

claim: Independent travel blog describes Cycling Through the Trees as 'a fabulous and thrilling gimmick' and 'utterly wonderful', confirming the experience lives up to the marketing for a destination ride.
quote: The blog review from 'Notes from Camelid Country' describes it as a fabulous and thrilling gimmick, and utterly wonderful, showing how the Flemish region of Limburg has gone the extra mile to lure cyclists to the region

claim: The Sahara walk in Lommel is an 11.70 km red-triangle-marked loop through dunes, lakes, heather and pine forest, starting at House of Nature (Speelpleinstraat 201, 3920 Lommel) and reaching the 30 m Reus van Bosland observation tower.
quote: The route spans 11.70 km through Bosland National Park. Parking is available at House of Nature (Speelpleinstraat 201, 3920 Lommel). The 'Reus van Bosland' stands 30 metres high, offering panoramic views up to 25 km on clear days. Follow red triangle markers throughout.

claim: The Sahara hiking area at Speelpleinstraat in 3920 Lommel is free to enter, has a dog off-leash area (hondenlosloopweide) and includes a children's play forest plus the Reus van Bosland watchtower.
quote: Speelpleinstraat z/n, 3920 Lommel ... Target price (adult) € 0,- ... Hondenlosloopweide ... Uitkijktoren - De Reus van Bosland ... Speelbos

claim: Nationaal Park Bosland groups distinct walking areas (Sahara, Pijnven, In den Brand, Kattenbos, Heuvelse Heide, Resterheide, Holven-'t Plat, Grote Hof-Hobos, Blauwe Kei-De Maat) and operates a wandelnetwerk where more than 70% of paths are quiet sand tracks.
quote: Pijnven ... 2,000 hectares of forest ... In den Brand ... rare sand dune system ... Kattenbos ... Leyssensmolen (grain mill from 1797) ... Resterheide ... buggy/wheelchair-accessible Lieveheersbeestjespad ... Bosland Wandelnetwerk ... 'meer dan 70%' on quiet sand paths.

claim: Heather around Lommel typically blooms mid-August to mid-September; prime spots are Heuvelse Heide (parking De Meerpaal, Boskantstraat 60), Kattenbos (2.2 km wheelchair-accessible Butterfly Walk), and Blekerheide reached by a steel pedestrian bridge over the Bocholt-Herentals canal (parking Lossingsweg).
quote: The heath usually blooms from mid-August to mid-September ... Heuvelse Heide ... Parking at De Meerpaal, Boskantstraat 60 ... Kattenbos ... 2.2-kilometer Butterfly Walk accommodates strollers and wheelchairs ... Blekerheide ... steel pedestrian bridge over the Bocholt-Herentals Canal. Parking at Lossingsweg z/n.

claim: Hageven-De Plateaux is a 600-ha cross-border reserve in Pelt (visitor centre De Wulp, Tussenstraat 10, Neerpelt) with eight walking routes from 1.38 km to 9.69 km; dogs allowed on-leash and the 1.38 km Hubert Lehaenpad is wheelchair/stroller accessible.
quote: Located in Limburg on the Belgian-Dutch border, this nature reserve spans 600 hectares ... Eight walking routes are available, ranging from 1.38 km to 9.69 km ... The 'Hubert Lehaenpad' is wheelchair and stroller-accessible at 1.38 km ... Dogs are welcome on-leash throughout the reserve.

claim: In den Brand near Hechtel-Eksel hosts the largest sandpit in Flanders with three marked loops of 2 km, 4.4 km and 5.5 km plus a 2-ha fenced off-leash dog park with separate zones for large and small dogs.
quote: The Nature Reserve In den Brand hosts the largest sandpit in Flanders. There are 3 walking routes mapped out from 2 to 5.5 km ... There is a 2-hectare dog park, fully fenced and located in a piece of woodland near the dunes of 'In den Brand'. There are separate zones for large and small dogs.

claim: Pijnven in Hechtel-Eksel is a 2,000+ ha pine and mixed forest area with play meadows, a treehouse and Butterfly Valley, traversed by routes including an easy 6.6 km orange loop.
quote: The Pijnven Orange Trail is an easy 6.6 km route offering scenic views within Pijnven Forest. The Pijnven is a forest of over 2000 hectares

claim: Kattenbos offers a 9.1 km loop through purple heathland and pine forest with chances to spot deer and badgers, best visited in August-September when the heather blooms; walks start at the Leyssensmolen car park.
quote: Kattenbos offers a 9.1 km hike through wide heathlands and quiet pine forests ... walk through purple heathlands and green pines, spot deer and badgers ... best time to visit is in August or September, when the heather bursts into bloom

claim: The Leyssensmolen, a wooden grain mill restored in 1988, sits at a popular walk start in Kattenbos and is open free to visitors on the 1st Sunday and 3rd Saturday of each month from 13:00–17:00.
quote: You can visit the mill for free every 1st Sunday and 3rd Saturday of the month between 1:00 PM and 5:00 PM ... In 1988 the mill was thoroughly restored and has been grinding grain again since then.

claim: Notable nearby outdoor attractions include the Lommelse Sahara suspension footbridge over the canal, the Fietsen door de Bomen 700 m elevated cycle path rising 10 m through the canopy in Hechtel-Eksel, and Klankenbos in Pelt with interactive sound-art sculptures.
quote: Fietsen door de Bomen ... a circular cycle path 700 metres long ... rising to a height of 10 metres ... Klankenbos ... interactive sound art sculptures created by European artists ... cross a suspension footbridge over the nearby canal

claim: Independent Komoot route data confirms multiple Sahara loops including a 12 km red, 5.9 km orange and 3.1 km blue children's trail, and longer 17.5–19.6 km Bosland border walks.
quote: A 12 km long red hiking trail, a 3.1 km blue children's trail, and a 5.9 km long orange trail ... A 19.6 kilometer walk that takes 5 hours ... A hiking route that is 17.5 kilometers long and takes approximately 4.5 hours

claim: Driving distance from Lommel to Maasmechelen (gateway to Mechelse Heide / Hoge Kempen National Park) is approximately 56–59 km, putting Mechelse Heide well outside the 30 km radius around Cuchara.
quote: The distance from Lommel to Maasmechelen is 35 miles by road (approximately 56 km). The road takes approximately 38 minutes. Alternatively, another source indicates the driving distance is 58.8 km

claim: Fietsen door de Bomen at Pijnven (Kiefhoekstraat 16, Hechtel-Eksel) is a free 700m double-circle bike bridge rising 3–4% to 10m height, open sunrise to sunset and accessible for walkers, wheelchairs and bikes.
quote: Accessible for cyclists, walkers and wheelchair users from sunrise to sunset ... path gradually rises (3-4%) to 10 meters height

claim: The Uitkijktoren ('Reus van Bosland') in the Lommelse Sahara is 30 m high, free to visit and accessible 24/7, with views up to 25 km; 4.6/5 rating across 253 reviews and ranked #1 of 24 things to do in Lommel.
quote: The observation tower stands 30 meters tall ... The attraction is completely free to visit ... accessible 24/7 ... rating of 4.6 out of 5 across 253 reviews and ranks #1 of 24 things to do in Lommel

claim: The Lommelse Sahara offers a 3.1 km blue children's trail through a play forest with willow-branch play elements, plus 5.9 km orange and 12 km red routes; sand makes it unsuitable for strollers.
quote: the blue route shows the most beautiful spots of the Sahara and offers plenty of variety for young and old ... the children's walk in the Sahara, passing through the mysterious play forest with natural play elements made of willow branches

claim: Sportcentrum De Soeverein in Lommel has a 25x15 m six-lane competition pool at 28°C plus a 10x12 m subtropical kids' pool at 31°C; single-swim entry is €4.20 for Lommel residents and €5.20 for non-residents.
quote: The competition pool is 25x15 meters with six lanes ... subtropical pool of 10x12 meters with a temperature around 31°C ... Lommel residents pay €4.20 and non-residents pay €5.20

claim: De Soeverein (Sportveldenstraat 15, 3920 Lommel) includes a separate children's pool, wellness with sauna/jacuzzi/steam, family water slide, outdoor spray park and brasserie with playground — but no ice rink on site.
quote: Separate children's pool · Wellness area with sauna, jacuzzi, and steam room · Family water slide · Outdoor spray park · Brasserie with playground ... There is no ice rink mentioned at this location

claim: Provinciaal Recreatiedomein Zilvermeer (Mol) charges €5 online per day for swimming + playground (age 6+), free under 6; tickets are date-locked and capacity-capped on warm days so pre-booking is advised.
quote: Swimming & Playground (ages 6+): €5 online ... Swimming & Playground (under 6): Free ... dit ticket is enkel geldig op de door jouw gekozen dag

claim: Zilvermeer features a sandy-beach swimming pond with climbing tower, water slides and whirlpools plus kayak, sail, tennis and volleyball — roughly 20 km from Lommel.
quote: plenty of water fun in the swimming pond with a climbing tower and water slides, whirlpools and a nice white sand beach ... swim as well as kayak, sail, play tennis, volleyball and more

claim: Center Parcs De Vossemeren in Lommel sells day tickets to non-staying visitors for around €25–€27 per person; Aqua Mundo includes a wave pool, wild-water rapids, slides, kids' pool and outdoor pool, plus paid add-ons like laser battle, paintball and High Adventure Experience.
quote: purchase a day ticket at the cashier for €27 per person, though ticket prices are around €25 per person ... wave pool, wildwater rapids, slides, a children's pool, outdoor pool ... air mattress water park, laser battle, paintball, Action Factory, and the High Adventure Experience

claim: Outdoor Adventure Parc Warredal in Maaseik (~30 km from Lommel) has seven climbing courses of varying difficulty plus a 200 m zipline, adult target price €24.95, by appointment only.
quote: Ketelstraat 77, 3680 Maaseik ... Target price (adult) € 24,95 ... seven courses offering different heights and levels of difficulty ... 200-meter zipline ... only available on appointment

claim: Blueberry Fields in Koersel (Beringen, ~25 km from Lommel) opens self-pick blueberry season mid-July to mid-August, 09:00–16:30 with €5 family entry refunded if you pick 1 kg; no reservation needed.
quote: Self-picking starts at 9:00 AM and the last pickers leave at 4:30 PM ... entrance fee is €5 per family, which is deducted if you pick at least 1 kg ... mid-July to mid-August

claim: Blauwe Meer at Kattenbos 169 in Lommel is an officially recognised supervised swimming pond with 'zeer goed' (very good) water-quality rating as of 15-09-2025.
quote: Op Kattenbos 169 in Lommel bevindt zich een zwemvijver, en de laatste waterkwaliteitsmeting op 15-09-2025 toonde een 'zeer goed' beoordeling

claim: Indoor Karting Lommel (Balendijk 171) runs a 500 m multi-level track with 200cc Honda karts, open to drivers from 1m50 tall, with on-site bowling and bar.
quote: 500-meter multi-level track ... children able to go-karting as young as 1m50 tall ... bowling as an additional activity available at the location

claim: Klimbos De Hoge Rielen in Kasterlee (slightly outside 30 km of Lommel) is closed 1 Dec 2025 – 1 Mar 2026; courses are for ages 11+ and ≥1.40 m, 2.5 hours, minimum 12 people, bookable by phone/email only.
quote: winterstop van 1 december 2025 t.e.m. 1 maart 2026 ... geschikt voor kinderen vanaf 11 jaar en minstens 1.40 meter groot ... minimale groepsgrootte is 12 personen

claim: Achelse Kluis abbey runs 1.5-hour guided tours Fri-Sun (Apr-Sep) at 11:00 and 14:00, weekend-only in winter, at 15 EUR including tasting of two Achel beers; brewery visits are not possible.
quote: April-September: Fri-Sun at 11:00 AM & 2:00 PM ... October-March: Sat-Sun at 1:30 PM & 3:30 PM ... 15 euros per person (includes tasting of two Achel Abbey beers) ... Brewery visits are not possible

claim: Achelse Kluis sits on the Belgian-Dutch border at the gateway to Nature Park De Groote Heide, with walking trails and a tasting cafe complementing the abbey grounds.
quote: De Achelse Kluis: a hidden abbey treasure at the gates of Nature Park De Groote Heide

claim: GlazenHuis, Lommel's contemporary glass-art museum, is closed for renovation until fall 2026 so likely unavailable for a 2026 weekend visit unless reopened.
quote: TIJDELIJK GESLOTEN OMWILLE VAN VERBOUWINGEN

claim: Lommel municipality confirms GlazenHuis and tourism office are undergoing a combined rebuild, with works running through 2026.
quote: Vernieuwbouw GlazenHuis en Visit Lommel

claim: be-MINE in Beringen is Flanders' largest industrial-heritage site, combining a mining museum with underground simulation, the Todi diving centre, Alpamayo climbing centre, Adventure Mountain and the be-NATURE coal-washes heritage walk.
quote: Mining Museum - Interactive experience exploring coal mining history with an underground simulation ... Alpamayo - Climbing center with ~1,300m of climbing walls ... Todi - Indoor snorkeling and diving center

claim: be-MINE's mining museum opens daily 10:00-17:00 with underground-simulation tours at 11:00, 13:00 and 15:00, ticketed at the Visit Beringen office.
quote: open every day from 10:00 to 17:00. Tours of the underground simulation start every day at 11 am, 1 pm and 3 pm

claim: Beringen is roughly 26 km / 26 minutes drive from Lommel, putting be-MINE just within a generous 30 km radius.
quote: the driving distance between Lommel to Beringen is 16 miles, which is approximately 25.75 kilometers

claim: Van Abbemuseum Eindhoven (contemporary art) is open Tue-Sun 11:00-17:00, adults 16 EUR, students 8 EUR, under-13 free, with free entry on Tuesdays 15:00-17:00.
quote: Adults: 16 ... Students/CJP cardholders/Teacher Card: 8 ... Tuesdays 3-5 PM: Free entry ... Tuesday to Sunday from 11 AM to 5 PM

claim: Eindhoven's Philips Museum opens Tue-Sun 11:00-17:00 (plus Mondays in school holidays), with free admission on Tuesday afternoons 15:30-17:00 outside holidays.
quote: open from Tuesday to Sunday between 11:00 and 17:00 hours ... free admission on Tuesday afternoons from 15:30 - 17:00 hours

claim: The iconic Evoluon UFO building in Eindhoven has reopened as the Next Nature Museum with the immersive RetroFuture exhibition exploring past and present visions of the future across ten tunnels.
quote: Eindhoven's most iconic building has re-opened to the public with the RetroFuture exhibition ... In ten tunnels filled with fiction and facts, the visions of yesterday's futurists are on display

claim: Lommel's Kattenbos German War Cemetery is the largest WWII cemetery in Western Europe (16 ha, 39,105 graves) with free entry and a downloadable Friedhof app for self-guided context.
quote: the largest WWII cemetery in Western Europe, covering 16 hectares ... more than 39,105 fallen soldiers ... Approximately 6,400 unidentified soldiers ... Around 1,200 child soldiers

claim: Bocholter Brouwerijmuseum spans 4,000 m of industrial-archaeology brewing exhibits (malt house, brewing hall, barrel and bottle workshop); individual tours run July-August Wed/Fri at 13:30 at 10 EUR pp with reservation.
quote: European brewery museum spans 4,000 m and showcases industrial archaeology ... Individual visitors: 10 per person ... Individual visits are available July-August on Wednesdays and Fridays at 1:30 PM

claim: Lommel's Sint-Pietersbandenkerk combines a 1388 medieval tower with a neo-Gothic nave (1900-1902), 32 Gustaaf Ladon stained-glass windows, a 63-bell carillon and Belgium's oldest extant Clerinx organ; free entry sunrise-to-sunset.
quote: medieval tower from 1388 ... 32 magnificent stained glass windows ... 63 bells or 5 octaves and is, together with the university carillon of Leuven, the second largest in our country ... oldest Clerinx organ

claim: Valkenswaard's Falconry and Cigar-making Museum (Oranje Nassaustraat 8b) opens Tue-Sat 13:00-17:00 and chronicles local cigar production from 1865 onward alongside the town's falconry tradition.
quote: Tuesday to Saturday from 13:00 - 17:00 ... showcases the development of cigar production in Valkenswaard from 1865

claim: Lommel's Archeologisch Museum De Kolonie closed permanently in 2021, so the city's prehistory collection is no longer publicly visitable as a museum.
quote: The museum has been closed since 2021 and will not reopen

claim: The Achelse Kluis brasserie is closed Mondays year-round; summer (Apr 1–Nov 30) opens Tue–Thu 10:00–20:00, Fri–Sat 10:00–22:00, Sun 10:00–22:00; kitchen closes one hour before closing.
quote: Summer (April 1 - November 30): Monday: Closed; Tuesday-Thursday: 10AM–8PM; Friday-Saturday: 10AM–10PM; Sunday: 10AM–10PM. The kitchen closes one hour before closing time.

claim: The 5° Bruin and Blond Achel beers are only available on draft at the cafeteria/brasserie, while the bottled product is the 8°.
quote: 5° Bruin and Blond beers (5% ABV) can only be tasted here on draft in the cafeteria, while the normal product in bottles is the 8° which is 8% ABV

claim: Achel lost the Trappist designation in January 2021 after its last two monks moved to Westmalle; the abbey and brewery were later bought by Belgian entrepreneur Jan Torman and beer continues to be produced but can no longer be sold as Trappist.
quote: In 2021 the monastery closed, with the last two remaining monks moving to Westmalle Abbey... Following closure, the abbey buildings and brewery were bought by Belgian entrepreneur Jan Torman. Beer continues to be produced, but can no longer be sold as Trappist

claim: The Bocholter Brouwerijmuseum, billed as Europe's largest brewery museum, occupies a 4,000 m² complex opposite the Martens brewery fermentation tanks and ends in a tasting room.
quote: Bocholter Brouwerij Museum is Europe's largest brewery museum... a multifunctional museum of 4.000 m²... pass by the transport department and into the tasting room

claim: Standard adult admission to the Bocholter Brouwerijmuseum is €10.00.
quote: Wondering what a ticket to Bocholter Brouwerij Museum - Brouwerij Martens costs? These are the prices: €10.00

claim: In the Gault&Millau 2026 guide for North Limburg, Cuchara leads at 17.5/20, while Lommel's Cocotte (Jan Mangelschots) was upgraded to 14.5/20, and Hamont-Achel's Food Emotions reached 14.5/20 with newcomer Stad10 at 14.
quote: Cuchara, a restaurant run by chef Jan Tournier in Lepelstraat, is the best restaurant in North Limburg with a score of 17.5/20. Restaurant Cocotte... received an upgrade to a score of 14.5/20... Food Emotions received an upgrade to 14.5/20, and Stad10 is a new entry with 14 points.

claim: Restaurant Cocotte, Koning Leopoldlaan 94 in Lommel, is led by chef Jan Mangelschots and serves Belgian-French modern cuisine.
quote: Chef: Jan Mangelschots; Cuisine Types: Belgian, French, and Modern; Address: Koning Leopoldlaan 94, 3920 Lommel, Belgium

claim: Stad10 in Hamont-Achel is run by chef Bert Brouwers, offering refined French-based cuisine with Japanese and acidic accents.
quote: Chef Bert Brouwers presents refined cuisine with a French foundation and international influences... Japanese and fresh acidic flavours frequently appear on the menu

claim: Food Emotions sits at Bosstraat 160 in Hamont-Achel, is run by chef Mark Bonneu, holds 14.5 Gault&Millau points and is combined with a gastronomic shop.
quote: Food Emotions is located at Bosstraat 160 in Hamont-Achel... run by chef Mark Bonneu and is combined with a gastronomic shop... Gault&Millau rating of 14.5/20

claim: Lommel's weekly market is held every Wednesday 13:30–17:30 on and around the Hertog Janplein, right next to Cuchara.
quote: The weekly market takes place every Wednesday from 13:30 to 17:30 on and around the Hertog Janplein

claim: The Hertog Jan Brouwerij in Arcen (NL) offers a standard one-hour brewery tour at €19,95 p.p., a Bockbier Tour at €24,95 and an exclusive Liefhebbers Tour at €54,95; reservation recommended.
quote: De reguliere rondleiding door de Hertog Jan Brouwerij kost €19,95 per persoon voor volwassenen vanaf 18 jaar. De Bockbier Rondleiding... voor €24,95 per persoon... De Liefhebbers Tour... voor €54,95

claim: White asparagus ("white gold") is harvested across Dutch/Belgian Limburg from mid-April through 24 June, making late-May the peak season for farm-shop and restaurant menus near Lommel.
quote: Asparagus the White Gold... harvesting of Limburgse asperges during April, May, and June

claim: The Philips Museum sits where Gerard Philips made his first light bulbs in 1891 and traces the company's rise from light bulbs to CDs to healthcare tech, with an iPad-led augmented-reality tour.
quote: tells the extraordinary story of the light-bulb maker turned multinational electronics company who invented the CD ... The iPad-led 'augmented-reality' tour adds nine extra design-focused elements

claim: Philips Museum admission is €12.50 adults / €6 students, free Tuesdays from 15:30 outside school holidays; the Evoluon (1966 retro-futurist dome) charges €16 / €8 students and opens Wed–Sun 11:00–17:00.
quote: Price: €12.50 for adults, €6 for students, free on Tuesdays from 3:30 PM ... Evoluon ... A regular ticket costs €16, and €8 for students; Opening hours: Wednesday to Sunday from 11 AM until 5 PM

claim: Strijp-S is Eindhoven's repurposed Philips factory district, now a creative hub of design studios, MU Hybrid Art House, Area 51 skatepark, food trucks and the annual Dutch Design Week.
quote: Strijp-S serves as a hub for creative professionals, hosting exhibitions, workshops, and events ... MU Hybrid Art House features contemporary exhibitions ... Area 51 Skatepark is one of the largest skateparks in Europe

claim: Eurocircuit Valkenswaard is the only permanent off-road racing centre in the Netherlands, 1033 m long (60% paved, 40% unpaved), set in forest between Eindhoven and the Belgian border; a Rallycross weekend is scheduled 20–21 June 2026.
quote: The Eurocircuit is located near Valkenswaard in a forested environment between Eindhoven and the Belgian border, and is the only permanent Off Road Racing Center in the Netherlands ... 1033 meters, of which 60% is paved and 40% unpaved

claim: Sint-Martinuskerk in Weert is a late-Gothic hall church with a 72 m tower, one of only two such hallenkerken left in the Netherlands and home to among the largest continuous late-Gothic vault paintings in the country.
quote: Sint Martinus Church in Weert is an imposing, late-gothic hall church. The 72-metre high tower ... one of only two remaining examples of this architectural style in late-gothic in the Netherlands ... largest continuous late Gothic vault paintings

claim: Sint-Martinuskerk visitor hours are Tue–Fri 11:00–12:00 (Mar–Oct) and 14:00–16:00, Saturday 09:00–16:00, Sunday 14:00–16:00.
quote: open for viewing Tuesday to Friday from 11:00 to 12:00 (March through October) and 14:00 to 16:00, Saturday 09:00 to 16:00 and Sunday 14:00 to 16:00

claim: Recreatiegebied de IJzerenman in Weert is a sport-and-relaxation lake area combining swimming at Zwembad De IJzeren Man, natural camping Wega, a petting farm and minigolf.
quote: Recreatiegebied de IJzerenman is a versatile sports, relaxation and recreation area in Weert, with swimming at Zwembad De IJzeren Man, relaxation at natural camping Wega ... feed goats, lambs and rabbits at a petting farm or play minigolf

claim: 't Spectrum was founded in Bergeijk in 1941 as a sister to weaving mill De Ploeg; Martin Visser headed its design department from 1954 and hired Friso Kramer, Constant Nieuwenhuys and Benno Premsela, producing icons like the BR 02 sofa bed.
quote: 't Spectrum was founded in Bergeijk in 1941 ... In 1954 Martin Visser became head of Spectrum's design department ... hired great designers such as Friso Kramer, Constant Nieuwenhuys and Benno Premsela ... BR 02 sofa bed as its most famous icon
